⚠️ ما لا تغطيه هذه الحاسبة: ⚠️ What this calculator does not cover
المؤمّن عليهم الجدد لأول مرة بعد آخر تعد: People insured for the first time after the latest amendment to the law have somewhat stricter early-retirement conditions (age 55 for men / 52 for women instead of 50/45) — if you joined Social Security for the first time very recently, check your personal account.
العاملين بالمهن الخطرة إلهم شروط تقاعد م: Workers in hazardous occupations have different early-retirement conditions (lower age, fewer contributions).
لا تطبّق الحاسبة سقفاً على القفزة الكبير: The calculator does not apply a cap on a large jump in the average wage right before retirement (the law sets a maximum limit on the increase of the average over your wage 4 to 5 years before retirement, and this calculator does not apply it).
لا تشمل رواتب الاعتلال (العجز) أو تقاعد: It does not include disability pensions or death (survivors') pensions — these are entirely separate cases in the law.
المقارنة بين المسارين مبنية على افتراض أ: The comparison between the two tracks assumes that you keep working and contributing continuously from your current age (without interruption), and that your salary stays close to the figure you entered until retirement; any real change in your career (a break, a major salary change) will change the actual result.
كيف يُحسب راتب تقاعد الشيخوخة؟: How is the old-age retirement pension calculated?
2.5% عن كل سنة اشتراك من أول 1500 دينار: 2.5% for each year of contributions on the first 1,500 JOD of your average monthly wage (last 36 contributions), and 2% for each year of contributions on the portion of that average above 1,500 JOD.
ما شروط استحقاق راتب تقاعد الشيخوخة؟: What are the eligibility conditions for the old-age retirement pension?
إكمال سن الستين للذكر أو الخامسة والخمسي: Reaching age sixty for men or fifty-five for women, with at least 180 contributions to Social Security (84 of them actual contributions).
إكمال سن 50 مع 252 اشتراكاً فعلياً للذكر: Reaching age 50 with 252 actual contributions for men or 228 for women, or reaching age 45 with 300 actual contributions regardless of gender — under the general track in Article 64 of the Social Security Law.
لماذا راتب التقاعد المبكر أقل من راتب تق: Why is the early-retirement pension lower than the old-age pension?
لأن راتب التقاعد المبكر يُخفَّض بنسبة مع: Because the early-retirement pension is reduced by a certain percentage according to your age at retirement (from 20% at age 45 down to 2% at age 59 for men, with similar rates for women) — the younger you retire, the higher the reduction.
لا، هي أداة تقديرية تغطي الحالة العامة ف: No, it is an estimation tool that covers the general case only. It does not cover hazardous occupations, transitional tracks older than the law, or the cap on the average-wage adjustment for large jumps before retirement.
